name: Surabaya Orthopedic Half Marathon (SOHM) 2026
short_description: SOHM 2026 is a half marathon event in Surabaya, Indonesia, held on September 13, 2026, with 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distance options.
ai_summary: The Surabaya Orthopedic Half Marathon (SOHM) 2026 takes place on September 13, 2026, at The Caribbean Grande Pakuwon City in Surabaya, Indonesia. Runners can choose from three distances: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km. Registration is currently open, with prices ranging from Rp 137.500 to Rp 450.000 depending on the chosen distance and category.

research_highlights: The 2025 edition drew about 2,990 runners, including 30 participants who were orthopedic-surgery survivors, at Caribbean Grande Pakuwon City, Surabaya.
The course at Pakuwon City is described by a race calendar site as mostly flat, making it a popular spot for chasing personal bests.
In the run-up to the 2025 race, organizer PABOI held three consecutive days of 'health talk' sessions on safe, ergonomic running before race day.

The event has distinct categories beyond standard age-groups: a 10K category specifically for survivors of lower-limb bone/joint surgery, and a doctors-only competitive category within the Half Marathon.
Race pack pickup in the 2025 edition was held on the Friday and Saturday before race day (10:00–20:00 WIB), and baggage drop-off on race morning opened at 04:00 and closed at 09:30 WIB.
research_watchouts: Organizers explicitly state they do not accept liability for valuables left at the participant baggage check, and any loss is the participant's own responsibility.
Bib numbers cannot be transferred or resold to another runner; doing so can result in disqualification.

faqs.question: When is the Surabaya Orthopedic Half Marathon (SOHM) 2026?
faqs.answer: The Surabaya Orthopedic Half Marathon (SOHM) 2026 is scheduled to take place on September 13, 2026. The event will be held in Surabaya, Indonesia, at The Caribbean Grande Pakuwon City venue, giving participants a specific date to plan their travel and training around.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at SOHM 2026?
faqs.answer: SOHM 2026 offers three distance categories for participants to choose from: a 21.1km half marathon, a 10km race, and a shorter 5km race. This range allows runners of different experience levels and fitness goals to find a suitable distance to participate in.

faqs.question: Where is SOHM 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The race is held at The Caribbean Grande Pakuwon City, located in Surabaya, Indonesia. This venue serves as the central location for the event on September 13, 2026, hosting all three distance categories: the 21.1km, 10km, and 5km races.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to register for SOHM 2026?
faqs.answer: Registration prices for SOHM 2026 range from Rp 137.500 to Rp 450.000, depending on the distance category and registration package selected. Registration is currently open, so interested runners can sign up now within this stated price range for their preferred race distance.
